faq_q1_title: Q: What is the typical turnaround time for an enterprise accessibility audit?
faq_a1_desc: A: A standard enterprise portal audit (5 to 15 key journeys) is completed within 5 to 7 business days, including detailed bug playbooks and developer remediation guidance.
faq_q2_title: Q: Does A11yOmni introduce any performance overhead or render blocking?
faq_a2_desc: A: No. A11yOmni is engineered with an ultra-lightweight client-side footprint that loads asynchronously, ensuring 0% render blocking and preserving top-tier Core Web Vitals.
faq_q3_title: Q: In what format are official VPAT 2.5 reports delivered?
faq_a3_desc: A: VPAT reports are authored in the standardized ITI format (Word/PDF) and include formal Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) disclosures ready for government tender submission.
faq_q4_title: Q: Does your certification protect against ADA lawsuits and statutory penalties?
faq_a4_desc: A: Yes. Our WCAG 2.2 AAA audits and ongoing A11yOmni monitoring establish verifiable legal defense documentation, demonstrating robust compliance under US ADA, Section 508, and global mandates.
faq_q5_title: Q: Do we need to rewrite our frontend code to resolve accessibility failures?
faq_a5_desc: A: No. A11yOmni resolves common DOM-level barriers dynamically, while our audit playbooks provide targeted, minimal refactoring patches that fit seamlessly into your existing sprints.
faq_q6_title: Q: Do you perform native mobile application audits (iOS & Android)?
faq_a6_desc: A: Yes. We conduct thorough native audits across iOS (VoiceOver) and Android (TalkBack) for Swift, Kotlin, React Native, and Flutter mobile applications.
faq_callout_body: Our accessibility architects and leadership team are available for direct engineering consultations.
